formula: (intraday_return - overnight_return) * regime_weight, where regime_weight = 1.5 on high-volume days, 0.7 on low-volume days, else 1.0

def factor_overnight_intraday_pressure_volregime(df):
    """Intraday-minus-overnight pressure with volume regime amplification for high conviction days."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight, intraday = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    pressure = intraday - overnight
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    factor = np.where(is_high_vol > 0, pressure * 1.5, np.where(is_low_vol > 0, pressure * 0.7, pressure))
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_pressure_volregime"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_pressure_volregime"]
description: The base pressure (intraday - overnight) captures directional conviction. High-volume days carry stronger informational conviction, so the signal is amplified by 1.5. Low-volume days are noisy, so the signal is dampened by 0.7. This discrete regime adaptation preserves the core economic mechanism while emphasizing high-conviction periods, aiming to improve RankIC and ICIR without distorting the raw directional bet.
